area: Global Search V2 - V1 Regression Suite
title: Work Orders results appear only for users with Work Orders access
preconditions: Two test users: User A whose role includes 'Work Orders - View'; User B whose role does NOT include it.
At least one Work Order exists whose number or customer matches the search word you will type.
steps: Sign in as User A and open global search.
Type a word that matches an existing Work Order.
Note whether Work Order results appear.
Sign out, sign in as User B, and repeat the same search.
expected:
1. User A sees Work Order results.
2. User B sees NO Work Order results (the Work Orders group does not appear for them).
3. No other change to what each user can otherwise see.

---
This is the expected behaviour based on the EXISTING behaviour BEFORE the V2 deployment (the V1 regression baseline), not on assumption. Traceable source: INV-72 (WO) - ShopView/shopview@5576716 - FetchDataQueryHandler.php:42-67. The V2 spec (Global Search Product Requirements v1.2, Confluence page 576978945, version 12) preserves existing role-based access (section 9), so this behaviour must still hold after V2; if it changes, it is a regression to raise.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 8/26/2026
design_ref: V1 behaviour baseline (fact); not a design artefact.
